whole_source.workspace_reuse_proof: Each call starts with all private/noninput banks zero. Clean primitives preserve inputs and XOR fresh outputs. Literal F/outputXOR/F^-1 returns every private bank zero. Sequential calls reuse one fixed bank; all original SSA storage/scratch remains allocated.
